data.desc: Tree nodes to display. Nested by default (each node may have a `children` array); flat (self-referential) when `parent-key` is set. The array and its nodes are never mutated

columns.desc: Column definitions: { name, label, field (String | Function), align, sortable, sortingType ('number' | 'date' | 'custom'), sortingFunc, sort, filterable, format, classes, style, headerClasses, headerStyle }

node-key.desc: Property (or function) that uniquely identifies a node. Required for keys in `v-model:expanded` / `v-model:selected` to survive data reloads. Without it, node object identity is used

children-key.desc: Property holding a node's children (nested data)

parent-key.desc: Turns on flat (self-referential) data: each node points to its parent through this property. Nodes without a (known) parent become roots. `node-key` defaults to 'id' in this mode

tree-column.desc: Name of the column that shows the indentation and expand toggle (defaults to the first column)

expanded.desc: Keys of expanded nodes (use with v-model:expanded). Leave undefined to let QHierarchy manage it

default-expand-all.desc: Expand every node on first render (and when `data` is replaced)

default-expand-level.desc: Expand nodes down to this depth on first render (1 = roots expanded)

expand-on-row-click.desc: Toggle a row when it is clicked (default body only). Legacy spelling `expand_on_row_click` is still accepted

filter.desc: Search term. Shows matching nodes plus their ancestors; ancestors are auto-expanded while filtering

filter-method.desc: Custom predicate (node, term, columns) => Boolean. By default, columns with `filterable: true` are searched (all columns if none is filterable)

filter-min-length.desc: Minimum term length before filtering kicks in

filter-keep-descendants.desc: Also keep the descendants of matching nodes (collapsed) in the filtered result

selection.desc: Row selection mode; adds a checkbox column

selected.desc: Keys of selected nodes (use with v-model:selected)

strict-selection.desc: Multiple selection without cascading: parents and children are selected independently (no tri-state)

virtual-scroll.desc: Render only the rows in view (QVirtualScroll). Give the component a fixed height, for example style="height: 480px". Implies a sticky header

virtual-scroll-item-size.desc: Row height estimate in px (defaults to 48, or 28 when dense)

virtual-scroll-slice-size.desc: Minimum number of rows to render in the virtual list

virtual-scroll-sticky-size-start.desc: Height of the sticky header in px (defaults to the row height)

sticky-header.desc: Keep the header visible while scrolling (combine with a max-height). Background via --q-hierarchy-header-bg

expand-icon.desc: QIcon name for the expand toggle (default: inline 'add' SVG, no icon font needed)

collapse-icon.desc: QIcon name for the collapse toggle (default: inline 'remove' SVG)

separator.desc: Use a separator/border between rows, columns or all cells

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color (follows Quasar Dark mode when not set)

bordered.desc: Applies a default border to the component

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

classes.desc: CSS classes for the table container

no-data-label.desc: Message when there is no data

no-results-label.desc: Message when the filter matches nothing

footer-text.desc: Text for a single footer row. Legacy spelling `footer_text` is still accepted

footer-class.desc: Classes for the footer cell. Legacy spelling `footer_class` is still accepted

body.desc: Replaces a whole body row: render the <td> cells yourself. Suggestion: td

row.desc: Row meta: { key, index, level, expanded, hasChildren, loading, parent, posinset, setsize }

hasChildren.desc: Does the node have (or lazily load) children

setPadding.desc: setPadding(item) — returns the indentation style string

cell-[name].desc: Content of the cell for column [name] (the <td>, indentation and toggle are kept)

cell.desc: Content of every cell (cell-[name] takes precedence)

header.desc: Replaces the header row content. Suggestion: th

sortBy.desc: sortBy(col) — sort by a column (toggles asc/desc)

no-data.desc: Content shown when there are no (matching) rows

sort_column.desc: Emitted when a column is sorted

update:expanded.desc: Emitted when nodes are expanded/collapsed (enables v-model:expanded)

update:selected.desc: Emitted when the selection changes (enables v-model:selected)

lazy-load.desc: Emitted when a node with `lazy: true` is expanded for the first time

details.desc: { node, key, done(children), fail() } — call done() with the children array, or fail() to collapse and allow a retry

row-click.desc: Emitted when a row is clicked (not when clicking the toggle or checkbox)

row-dblclick.desc: Emitted when a row is double clicked

expandToLevel.desc: Expand nodes down to a depth (1 = roots expanded)

returns.desc: Row meta objects ({ node, key, level, ... })

scrollTo.desc: Scroll a visible row into view

focusRow.desc: Move keyboard focus to a visible row

refresh.desc: Recompute the rows after mutating plain (non-reactive) data in place
